diag.detail.attention.fail: No valid/recent Attention DataRow has been detected.
diag.detail.attention.ok: Fresh Attention values are being received from ThinkGear.
diag.detail.attention.raw: Attention is being calculated locally from the live RAW EEG stream.
diag.detail.attention.wait: The stream is active; waiting for the first Attention update.
diag.detail.bands.fail: Too few EEG bands contain valid activity.
diag.detail.bands.ok: Most EEG bands are being received.
diag.detail.bands.raw: All eight EEG bands are being calculated locally from the live RAW stream.
diag.detail.bands.wait: The stream is active; waiting for the first eight-band EEG power update.
diag.detail.baud.fail: The link is not configured for the required 57,600 bps RAW mode.
diag.detail.baud.ok: The acquisition link is fixed at 57,600 bps as required for 16-bit RAW.
diag.detail.checksum.fail: Packet checksum error rate is too high or there is not enough data.
diag.detail.checksum.ok: Packet checksum error rate is within the limit.
diag.detail.checksum.warn: Some checksum errors were detected; communication is working but the link is noisy.
diag.detail.meditation.fail: No valid/recent Meditation DataRow has been detected.
diag.detail.meditation.ok: Fresh Meditation values are being received from ThinkGear.
diag.detail.meditation.raw: Meditation is being calculated locally from the live RAW EEG stream.
diag.detail.meditation.wait: The stream is active; waiting for the first Meditation update.
diag.detail.raw.fail: There are not enough raw EEG samples yet.
diag.detail.raw.flat: Raw EEG is nearly flat; check electrodes and acquisition.
diag.detail.raw.rate: RAW is arriving, but the measured sample rate is below the expected ~512 Hz.
diag.detail.stream.fail: No recent valid EEG packets were detected.

diagnostics.sequence.help: Diagnostics checks the transport and the actual RAW pipeline. POOR_SIGNAL is not a pass/fail test and never blocks Attention, Meditation or BCI.
diagnostics.subtitle: Verify the acquisition chain in one reproducible order, without parallel tests or hidden exceptions.

validation.period_help: Validation records new, independent timed trials for every class. Training epochs are never reused.
